resources.string: Alerts from RideMate\'s server for the app owner: errors, spending, reading accuracy.
Open the alert email for details and follow the matching runbook.
Check the Modal logs, then follow the rollback runbook if a deploy caused it.
Read-screen p95 is above 15 s. Follow the Modal-down runbook.
Verified rows fell below 70%. A ride app may have changed: follow the ride-app-update runbook.
Over 20% of ride-app notifications miss their templates. Follow the ride-app-update runbook.
Users are getting extra questions because the classifier is unavailable. Check the cap and Modal runbooks.
Spend passed 70% of today\'s cap or 80% of a budget. Follow the cap-tripped runbook.
RideMate\'s meter and Modal\'s billing differ by over 10%. Caps were tightened; follow the cap-tripped runbook.
Firestore writes passed 70% of the free daily quota. ONDC is affected first: follow the ONDC runbook.
The synthetic golden-image read failed. Follow the model-removed and Modal-down runbooks.
The pinned Muse Spark Open model id is gone, so AI is off. Follow the model-removed runbook.
A service-account key needs rotating. Follow the key-rotation runbook.
Alert pushes reach this phone. Record the date in docs/slo-and-alerts.md.
